products.name: PACE Pattern
products.description:
## PACE Pattern

The framework you're using right now! Build AI-native storefronts in minutes.

### Features
- 15KB lightweight
- Zero dependencies
- Framework agnostic
- AI-powered chat
- Executive summary insights

### Get Started
```bash
npm install @semanticintent/pace-pattern
```

products.name: MillPond Storefront
products.description:
## MillPond Storefront

The official reference implementation showing PACE.js in production.

### What's Included
- Full PACE implementation
- Cormorant Foraging tools
- MCP server catalog
- AI-powered product discovery

### Interactive Demo
Explore the PACE 1.0.1 pattern at demo.millpond.dev

products.name: Your MCP Server
products.description:
## Your MCP Server

This is a placeholder product to show how MCP servers can be listed.

### Replace with your own:
```json
{
  "id": "my-mcp-server",
  "name": "My MCP Server",
  "tagline": "Does something cool",
  "category": "mcp_servers",
  "price_display": "free",
  "action": "github",
  "action_url": "https://github.com/you/repo"
}
```

products.name: Your Product Here
products.description:
## Your Product Here

PACE.js supports unlimited products in any category.

### Product types you can add:
- 🔌 MCP Servers
- 🛠️ Tools & Services  
- 📘 Templates & Blueprints
- 🎓 Courses & Training
- 📦 Packages & Libraries
- 🎨 Themes & Plugins

### Next steps:
1. Read the [documentation](https://github.com/semanticintent/pace.js)
2. Customize this example
3. Deploy your storefront
4. Share with the community!
